<div class="card-body">
'''URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウの狩猟用ライフル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費してア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウかバスト隊長に配備する。あるいは3フォース消費してドロイド以外のキャラクター（戦士以外でも可）に配備する。1フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは運命数－1＞能力値なら命中する。生物は運命数＋2＞防御値なら即座にロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-URoRRuRRRs-Hunting-Rifle-SWCA-67758.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タスケンの社会では、狩猟用ライフルを所有している者は地位が高い。ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウはアンカーヘッド付近に墜落した宇宙船からこの武器を回収した。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 1 Force to deploy on URoRRuR'R'R or Chief Bast. Or spend 3 Force to deploy on a non-droid character (even a non-warrior). Spend 1 Force to activate it. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny minus 1 is greater than ability. A creature is immediately lost if destiny plus 2 is greater than defense value.

'''Lore:'''
In Tusken society, owning a hunting rifle marks high status. URoRRuR'R'R recovered this weapon from a starship that crashed near Anchorhead.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 起動する (activate) where the English original says may target using 1 Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[URoRRuR'R'R's Hunting Rifle]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
